purpose: Release 224 phone texture copies: cut iOS GPU texture memory. Originals untouched; copies are new files.

tool.method: Only image bufferView payloads are replaced; all other bufferViews are copied byte-for-byte in original order, offsets rewritten, glTF JSON otherwise unchanged. No accessors, meshes, skins, inverse binds, nodes or animations are re-encoded.
tool.resize: Pillow LANCZOS, longest edge capped, aspect preserved, images already within the cap are untouched (original bytes).
tool.encode: JPEG stays JPEG (quality 90, 4:4:4, optimize); PNG stays PNG (optimize). No format or colour-space change.

Web/public/assets/donor/warrior-phone.gl.changedImages: images 16 and 30 (2048 -> 1024); the other 32 images were already <= 1024

estimatedGpuMB.basis: RGBA8 with full mip chain (x4/3) per image, all 34 images

art/phone-texture/warrior-phone512.glb.status: OPTIONAL, NOT wired into any manifest. For Dom's decision from the stills.
art/phone-texture/warrior-phone512.glb.cap: colour/emissive maps 1024, normal / metallic-roughness / AO maps 512
